thread:
Maya: Quick post-launch pulse. Daily active flows look OK but retention on the new onboarding prompt dropped ~8% after the release. We need to pick what is hotfixed this week vs queued for next sprint. My suggested rule: hotfix if it causes session-abort, revenue impact, or enterprise SLA hits. Everything else goes to the enhancement backlog. Thoughts?

Oliver: Agreed. From error logs: (1) onboarding JS error causing session abort on older Safari -> hotfix. (2) nonblocking layout flicker on mobile -> enhancement. (3) metrics emitter missed events under backpressure -> borderline, affects analytics accuracy for several customers.

Nina: Enterprise signals: two customers reported onboarding timeouts causing failed sign-ups. They are on paid plans. Recommend prioritizing the Safari error and adding a temporary client-side guard to retry the event emitter.

Raj: Dev estimates: Safari fix ~0.75d, client-side guard + retry 0.5d, backend metrics emitter fix ~1.5d (requires infra coord). Also propose a short canary that disables the new onboarding prompt for 3% of traffic as an immediate mitigation.

Sasha: Ops + rollout: canary plan 3% -> 20% -> 100% over 3h with auto-rollback on session-abort > 0.2% or error-rate +0.4% absolute. I can own rollout. Suggested routing snippet: 
```
route: feature_onboarding_prompt == false
percent: 3
```

Maya: Proposed Wave A (this week): Safari crash fix, client-side emitter retry, canary-disable for onboarding prompt for 3% to reduce blast radius, enterprise comms. Wave B (next sprint): backend emitter refactor, mobile layout polish, telemetry hardening. Anyone object?

Oliver: No objections. Add acceptance criteria for Wave A: onboarding success rate >= baseline - 0.5% on canary for 4h, no session aborts in canary, and enterprise sign-up path verified end-to-end.

Nina: I'll draft customer notes and flag the two affected customers for immediate outreach.

QA Bot: CI snapshot: 5 failing tests (2 flaky). Will prioritize smoke tests for Safari fix and end-to-end signup flow after PRs land.

Raj: Action items: Oliver (Safari fix), Raj (client-side guard + tests), Sasha (canary routing + alerts), Nina (customer comms), QA Bot (post-deploy checks). Target: start canary tomorrow 09:00 UTC.

Maya: Thanks team. I'll update the board, tag tickets as hotfix-this-week, and schedule a 30m pulse 2h after canary starts. :white_check_mark:
